name: refuse model dispatch bindings on an external recording
comment: Without the refusal, a recording can serve llm.base_url or a provider endpoint and stand in for the finite world or the declared gateway.

name: claim the action seam ahead of the recording catch-all
old:
if before is not None:
                before(name, app)
comment: Without the hook, the recorded POST /v1/actions row answers instead of the real DurableActionService.

name: keep the action seam when the recording binds no signal reads
old: if signal is None and "platforms.signal.base_url" not in self.generated_bindings:
comment: Without the writes-only app the signal binding is unowned: no recorded read, no generated fill.

name: check the recording's consumption after the environment
new:
if playback is not None:
                environment.check()
comment: Without playback.check, an unconsumed declared response closes silently.

name: carry the declared external recording into the journey plan
comment: Without the parse, the manifest's recording never reaches JourneyServices.
